C1777.title: Automotive OTA Updates Become Prime Target for Hackers
C1777.summary: An industry forum in December 2025 reported that the networking of core components such as T-BOX and ECU, along with the widespread adoption of OTA, has significantly expanded the vehicle attack surface. OTA functionality, a critical feature of intelligent connected vehicles, has become a primary target for hackers, who can hijack or tamper with update packages to perform malicious flashing.
